_meta.units: art px, origin top-left of the 256x320 canvas (same registration as loft-iso.png)
_meta.source: PLACEHOLDER — swap loft-iso.png + this map when Sprite Smith delivers Loft art. Schema matches hideout-iso.map.json.
drawOrder: window (day or night — drives ambient light)
glow overlay when lamp on at night (baked, no code spotlight)
pet (sleep target = bed top, not the walk floor)
loft-iso-front when pet is behind a prop
_meta.depthRule: iso box rule: for each prop, edgeY(x) = frontCorner.y - |x - frontCorner.x| / 2. Pet is BEHIND the prop when pet feet y < edgeY(feet x) and the pet sprite overlaps the prop rect.
_meta.sleep: targets.bed is ON TOP of the bed (inside the bed footprint). Do not clamp sleep to the walk polygon.
_meta.lamp: spots.lamp is a tap target. It toggles the baked loft-glow overlay at night only.

interior.note: PLACEHOLDER hull copied from hideout-iso so integer scale / clip math match until real Loft art lands.
